technical_profileName.label: Notification profile name
technical_profileName.help: Additional outbound-only profile; separate from the assistant conversation.

technical_mainChatId.label: Main Telegram owner ID
technical_mainChatId.help: Private numeric user ID. Shared inbox requires Allowed users to contain only this ID.

technical_sharedInbox.label: Shared Telegram / WebUI inbox
technical_sharedInbox.help: Pins Powiadomienia above Czat główny after gateway restart. Technical notifications are optional. Main history stays in the Telegram session.

technical_enabled.label: Outbound-only technical notifications
technical_enabled.help: Optional names/status-only additional profile. Main Telegram becomes answer-only. No arguments, results, reasoning or raw logs are copied.

technical_chatId.label: Technical chat ID
technical_chatId.help: Dedicated group/channel numeric ID. Inbound messages there are ignored when using the main bot.

technical_token.label: Technical bot token (optional)
technical_token.help: Blank reuses the main bot. A technical DM requires a separate bot; this bot is never polled.

technical_includeToolEvents.label: Include tool names and lifecycle status

technical_includeStatusEvents.label: Include turn, retry and context status
